⚠️ REQUIRES JAVASCRIPT RENDERING (Playwright/Selenium/Puppeteer) Denver Business Brokers uses Salesstream CRM (https://denverbbs.salestreamcrm.com) which is a React-based single-page application. The listings page shows only
in static HTML - all content is loaded dynamically via JavaScript/API. IMPLEMENTATION OPTIONS: 1. Use Playwright/Puppeteer to render JavaScript and extract data from DOM 2. Reverse-engineer the Salesstream API by inspecting network calls in browser DevTools 3. Contact broker for API access or data feed The main listing pages all redirect to the same Elementor-built WordPress page (page-id-5060) which likely contains an embedded Salesstream widget/iframe. URLs checked: - https://denverbbs.com/buy-a-business/ (main URL) - https://denverbbs.com/businesses-for-sale - https://denverbbs.com/listings - https://denverbbs.salestreamcrm.com/listings (React SPA) All point to Salesstream CRM integration which requires JavaScript execution.
